core_claim: NVIDIA was flat for a decade then exploded — revenue 61x and net income 474x from FY2011 to FY2026 — and the market priced it almost perfectly off those fundamentals while still re-rating each dollar of sales far higher.

edt_01.label: Hook — The cliff
edt_01.title: A Flat Decade, Then a Cliff
edt_01.editorial_notes: Revenue 61x and $3.54B -> $215.94B must be exact; lead with the flat-then-vertical shape, not the company history.

edt_02.label: The hinge year
edt_02.title: The Hinge: FY2023 to FY2024
edt_02.editorial_notes: Keep flat 0.2% (FY-end 2023) and +125.9% (FY-end 2024) exact and adjacent. The image is the atmospheric hero/chapter beat for the boom.

edt_03.label: Margins to a new tier
edt_03.title: Margins Climb a Staircase
edt_03.editorial_notes: Net-margin dip to 16.2% in FY-end 2023 and the >70% gross-margin tier must stay visible.

edt_04.label: The 474x profit line
edt_04.title: The Number That Matters: Net Income
edt_04.editorial_notes: 474x and $120.07B must be exact. Interactive should let the reader feel the scale jump from $0.25B to $120B.

edt_05.label: The EPS trap
edt_05.title: The EPS Trap
edt_05.editorial_notes: EPS $11.93 -> $2.94 and the 10:1 split must be exact. This is the signature caveat; never round into vagueness.

edt_06.label: The market was watching
edt_06.title: The Market Was Watching
edt_06.editorial_notes: 348x price, the $60.99 vs $60.92B near-touch, and correlation 0.991/0.992 must be exact. $5T milestone is context.

edt_07.label: The re-rating inside the correlation
edt_07.title: The Re-Rating Hiding in Plain Sight
edt_07.editorial_notes: Index values 6,094 (revenue) vs 34,752 (price) at FY-end 2026 must be exact; the point is correlation AND re-rating together.

edt_08.label: The volatility underneath / close
edt_08.title: Never a Smooth Ride
edt_08.editorial_notes: Returns +239% (2023), -50% (2022); R&D record $18.5B but only 8.6% of revenue. End on tension, not summary.
